title: NeoMint Tool Manifest
description: Initial tool vocabulary for the NeoMint Planner. 12 typed tools covering filesystem, applications, clipboard, system, notes, and settings. Tools NOT in this manifest are rejected by the policy engine.

tools.name: files.search
tools.description: Search for files matching criteria within allowed directory roots.

roots.description: Directory paths to search within. Must be within permitted scopes (e.g. ~/Documents, ~/Downloads).

modified_within_days.description: Only include files modified within this many days.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: files.list_directory
tools.description: List the contents of a single directory.

path.description: Directory path to list. Must be within permitted scopes.

tools.name: files.open
tools.description: Open a file with the system default application.

path.description: Path to the file to open. Must be within permitted scopes.

tools.name: files.move_to_trash
tools.description: Move a file or directory to the system Trash (recoverable deletion).

path.description: Path to move to Trash. Must be within permitted scopes.

tools.name: applications.list
tools.description: List installed GUI applications available for launching.

tools.name: applications.launch
tools.description: Launch a GUI application by its friendly name or desktop entry identifier.

tools.name: clipboard.read
tools.description: Read the current system clipboard text content.

tools.name: clipboard.write
tools.description: Write text to the system clipboard, replacing current contents.

text.description: Text to place on the clipboard.

tools.name: system.status
tools.description: Retrieve system status information: disk usage, memory, CPU, uptime, and OS version.

include.description: Which status categories to include. Omit for all.

tools.name: system.list_processes
tools.description: List running processes, optionally sorted by resource usage.

limit.description: Maximum number of processes to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: notes.create_draft
tools.description: Create a new text note file in the user's notes or documents directory.

title.description: Title for the note (used as filename stem).

tools.name: settings.show
tools.description: Open the system settings application, optionally to a specific panel.

panel.description: Specific settings panel to open (e.g. 'display', 'network', 'sound'). Omit for main settings.

excluded_tools.description: These tools are explicitly NOT in the first model's vocabulary. They require separate policy, UX, and evaluation work before inclusion.
